description: Natural terracotta tile in an 8x8 inch square format from Pak Clay. Fired clay gives a warm, earthy colour for floors and walls in verandahs, courtyards and living areas. The smaller square suits compact rooms and can be laid straight or on the diagonal for a livelier look. Clay is porous, so lay it on a sound base, keep standing water off it and ask your fixer about a breathable sealer. Shade varies between pieces, so order extra from one batch. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Natural terracotta tile in a 9x12 inch rectangular format from Pak Clay. The rectangle can be laid in rows, a running bond or a herringbone, giving a traditional clay look with a little pattern. Fired clay suits verandahs, kitchens and living areas, and its colour comes from the material, not paint. It is porous, so plan a sound base and ask about a breathable sealer. Colour varies naturally between pieces, so order a little extra. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Slim terracotta tile in a 9x3 inch format from Pak Clay, a long narrow piece suited to patterned layouts such as herringbone or running bond. Fired clay gives a warm natural colour for floors, borders and wall features. Narrow pieces need careful setting-out so lines stay straight, and extra tiles help cover cuts at the edges. Clay is porous, so ask about a breathable sealer and keep standing water off it. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Natural terracotta square tile in a 12x12 inch format from Pak Clay, shown in a living room setting. The larger square covers floor area quickly with fewer joints and gives a warm, earthy base for traditional or modern interiors. Fired clay is porous, so lay it on a sound base, protect it from standing water and ask your fixer about a breathable sealer. Shade varies between pieces, so order a little extra from one batch. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.
